events.title: Largest Bundibugyo virus outbreak in DRC
events.summary: WHO DON (14 Aug 2026): 4665 cases, 2184 deaths (CFR 46.8%) in DRC; largest BVD outbreak ever recorded.

events.title: Explosive Measles Epidemic in DRC
events.summary: China CDC (Jul 2026): DRC reported 10,550 new cases and 217 deaths in July, accounting for 84% of Africa's cases.

events.title: Resurgence of Measles in the Americas
events.summary: China CDC (Jul 2026): Mexico reports 19,074 cases; US reports 2,371 cases, highest since 1992.

events.title: Cholera Outbreak in Karal Health District, Chad
events.summary: OCHA (30 Jun 2026): Cholera outbreak in Karal district caused at least 13 deaths; risk of spread remains high.

events.title: Multi-country Dengue fever surge
events.summary: KDCA (Jul 2026): KDCA W28/2026 (Jul 2026): Americas report >1.5M dengue cases and 748 deaths; Brazil and Argentina most affected.

events.title: Global Cholera Outbreak Surge
events.summary: WHO (30 Jun 2026): 114,829 cases and 1,318 deaths globally since Jan 2026; 43% monthly increase in May.

events.title: Suriname Chikungunya Outbreak Surge
events.summary: IFRC (19 Mar 2026): Suriname confirms 1,357 Chikungunya cases and 1 death since late January outbreak declaration.

events.title: China SARS-CoV-2 cases rise to 522,000 in July 2026
events.summary: China CDC (13 Aug 2026): 522,000 new cases, 487 severe, 1 death in July; positivity rose to 21.2%.

events.title: Hong Kong High Influenza Activity Week 31 2026
events.summary: China CDC (Aug 2026): Hong Kong ILI% 15.3% (clinics), 45.1% (private); 20 school outbreaks reported.

events.title: Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever surge in Iraq
events.summary: UKHSA (13 Aug 2026): Iraq reports 313 CCHF cases and 24 deaths as of Aug 2026, with significant increase in Dhi Qar region.
